描述_EN: above, a frieze of circular motifs with spiral ends. the narrow piece (2) is essentially composed of a geometrically decorated cord and the remains of a linen ground cloth. the rectangular piece (1) features a frieze with two figures, one of which represents a putto carrying a bird. the set consists of two fragments adorned with decorative tapestry motifs.
描述_ZN: 上面是一个带有螺旋状末端的圆形图案的门楣。 狭长的一块（2）基本上是由一条有几何装饰的绳索和一块亚麻地布的残骸组成。 长方形作品(1)的门楣上有两个人物，其中一个代表一个抱着一只鸟的普特人。 这套作品由两块装饰有挂毯图案的碎片组成。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
